message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a bright yellow background. At the center is an isometric view of a large, yellow mining dump truck. Numerous black vultures, or similar scavenging birds with dark feathers and light-colored heads, occupy the scene. Three birds are in flight across the upper half, while one perches atop the truck’s dump body and another hangs off its side. Around the base of the truck, twelve additional birds are clustered on the ground.

The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, light yellow capital letters across the top. Below this, the red text "FREEPORT BUAT SIAPA" is prominently displayed. Smaller black text follows: "SELAIN PERUSAHAAN NEGARA, SEJUMLAH SAUDAGAR SWASTA NASIONAL MULAI MENGATUR STRATEGI MENGUASAI TAMBANG DENGAN CADANGAN EMAS TERBESAR DI DUNIA INI."

Additional black text at the very top reads, "PARA POLITIKUS DI SKANDAL E-KTP" and "MENTERI YASONNA SOAL PENUHNYA PENJARA KITA". A red and white circular logo on the left contains "TEMPO 46". A barcode and date "6-12 MARET 2017" appear in the lower-left corner.
